answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47911 Country: India Title: Breaking the Ramdan fast Question: One of my friends works as mason. He was keeping fast this Ramadan also but one day due to extreme heat, humidity and heavy work load he could not bear the fast and had to end the fast during noon. Now, he will have to make qaza only or qaza and kaffarah both? Answer ID: 47911 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1439/B-329/TB=11/1434) If your friend broke the fast due to extreme hunger and thirst then only qaza is wajib on him not the kaffarah. قال الشرنبلالى: صائم أتعب نفسه فى عمل حتى اجهده العطش ، فأفطر لزمته الكفارة وقيل لا ، وبه أفتى بالبقالى. (رد المحتار 3/401 ط زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
